timestamp: end of hourly bin; retain per-file time_basis; not harmonised to UTC
history: 24 rows ending at row t (t-23 through t)
target: soil_moisture_m3m3 at t+24 hours; hourly mean, not instantaneous value
primary_moisture: channel 1, except Flanders median of at least 2 replicates
optional_inputs: Use observed columns with missingness masks; flag guarantees primary moisture history/target only, not complete weather
split: Split by site/series and chronological blocks before fitting preprocessing. Exclude windows crossing splits; embargo at least 48h at boundaries. Overlapping windows are not independent samples.
limitations: Quality flags are retrospective. Crop and depth availability differ; these 10 datasets do not establish 10 verified crops or complete irrigation controls.
